mentions.name: Build Your Own ALU
mentions.description: A browser-based kata of interactive exercises for building basic chips up to an ALU in HDL, created to supplement the first two chapters of The Elements of Computing Systems (Nand2Tetris) in a homeschool computing curriculum.
mentions.problem: No existing supplement (such as games like Human Resource Machine or Comet 64) covered the first two Nand2Tetris chapters, where you build basic chips up to an ALU in HDL.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I ended up starting creating a kind of browser based kata for those chapters here:

https://virissimo.info/build-your-own-alu/
